# PDF export dependencies

Loaded on demand from this installation; document contents never leave the browser.

- jsPDF 4.2.1: https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF (MIT; license in the distribution header).
- jsPDF-AutoTable 5.0.7: https://github.com/simonbengtsson/jsPDF-AutoTable (MIT; license in the distribution header).
- html2canvas 1.4.1: https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas (MIT; license in the distribution header).
- Noto Sans Regular: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/blob/main/hinted/ttf/NotoSans/NotoSans-Regular.ttf (SIL Open Font License; see NotoSans-LICENSE.txt). `noto-sans-regular.js` contains the base64 encoded TTF for jsPDF.

The versioned JavaScript distributions are copied unchanged from their npm releases on unpkg.com. Noto Sans was retrieved from the official repository on 2026-11-24.
